claims.nodeLabel: ODNI Memorandum ES 2026-00818 - Preliminary Guidance for Implementation of NDA Waiver
claims.text: The inclusion of 'oaths, or commitments' alongside written NDAs is drafted to reach oral secrecy commitments of the kind associated with unacknowledged special access programmes, which do not generate signed agreements a witness could point to. Reasoning: written NDAs alone would have been fully covered by the word 'agreements'; the additional terms are only load-bearing if unwritten obligations exist.

claims.text: ODNI ES 2026-00818 grounds the NDA-waiver implementation on 'Presidential Direction' rather than on any cited executive order number.
Every IC element must establish a 'PURSUE designee' within 30 days in coordination with ODNI; witnesses are told to report to AARO 'or to an authorized PURSUE representative.'
ODNI ES 2026-00818 names a 'PURSUE Task Force' with a 'review and declassification' function to which all IC UAP information is to be released.

No charter, executive order, roster, chair, budget line or location for the PURSUE Task Force is public as of 12 August 2026. Reasoning: it appears in the ODNI memorandum and in derivative reporting, and on no published organisational instrument at war.gov, aaro.mil, dni.gov or whitehouse.gov.
